verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents an official Software Agent SDK (Python library for building code agents) plus an OpenAPI spec and API access for automation, which supports SDK-based building against the product. However, evidence lacks details on SDK language coverage, versioning, code samples, or independent developer corroboration of building real integrations with it. Missing for 10: multi-language SDK support, concrete code examples/tutorials, independent third-party usage reports, and SDK versioning/release cadence documentation.
